text: Runbook v1: Project Atlas deploys from the canary branch through 2026-07-14.
Runbook v2: effective 2026-07-15, Project Atlas deploys from the ember branch. This supersedes canary for later deployments.
A dry run is required before every Project Atlas deployment.
SEV-1 hotfixes may skip the dry run only with approval from the incident commander.
Dana is the incident commander through 2026-07-20.
Effective 2026-07-21, Mina is the incident commander and supersedes Dana.
Normal exports are retained for 30 days.
Rare blue-seal exports are retained for 365 days instead of the normal period.
Team feedback: incident reports should use UTC timestamps.
Repeated team feedback: always record incident timestamps in UTC.
A designer suggested using dark-mode screenshots in release reports.
Another designer repeated the dark-mode screenshot suggestion.
The Search API retries failed upstream requests at most three times.
The Search API request timeout is five seconds.
Files in raw-sources are immutable and must never be edited.
Summaries, embeddings, indexes, and graphs are derived artifacts and must be rebuildable from raw sources.
The Orion service is owned by the Aurora team.
Ravi is the Aurora team on-call engineer for July 2026.
Cross-tenant deduplication keys must include tenant_id.
Unverified chat rumor: Atlas might move to the sapphire branch someday.
The cafeteria vegetarian menu changes every Wednesday.
Container health checks run on port 9080.
Billing invoices are archived for seven years.
The mobile application uses a cobalt accent for warning banners.
The documentation site is regenerated every night at 02:00 UTC.
The analytics warehouse refreshes customer cohorts every Monday.
Amber-seal exports are retained for 180 days.
Production database migrations require a rollback script.
